query: select now() as checked_at,(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',u.id,'equipmentCount',(select count(*) from public.user_equipments e where e.user_id=u.id),'receipt',exists(select 1 from private.initial_equipment_receipts r where r.user_id=u.id))) from public.users u where u.id in ('4392795b-e528-48ec-b323-900820209506','796dfc87-d4dd-42dc-b6c2-5657334cc825','25975265-f042-4dd1-8ffc-a12f8414a035')) as legacy_qa,(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'ids',jsonb_agg(id order by id)) from public.user_equipments where user_id='216907d1-92e3-4ba8-bafd-953bbd51faec') as fresh_equipment,(select jsonb_build_object('status',status,'outcome',outcome,'hp',current_hp,'expires_at',expires_at,'finalized_at',outcome_finalized_at) from public.raid_bosses where id='56d721b3-8f38-4ac4-939f-9d9ea3760c5d') as natural_expiry,(select jsonb_build_object('anonymous',is_anonymous,'emailConfirmed',email_confirmed_at is not null) from auth.users where id='216907d1-92e3-4ba8-bafd-953bbd51faec') as fresh_auth;
